meta.scope: Iraq Batch 9 — Residual densification: water stress / Tigris-Euphrates, and non-oil economic structure framing.

candidates.title: Water storage and Tigris-Euphrates basin statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and UN monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and monitoring on live water storage, reservoir levels and basin inflows. Iraq has experienced severe storage declines and recurrent drought; recent recovery episodes remain partial relative to long-term capacity. Upstream flows and transboundary arrangements are structural constraints.
candidates.notes: High-centrality environmental constraint node linking agriculture, climate and food security.

candidates.title: Non-oil economic structure framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from national accounts and sector sources
candidates.description: Analytical framing of the non-oil economy: manufacturing, construction, trade, transport, agriculture and public services. Non-oil activity is material for employment and domestic absorption but remains secondary to oil in value added and fiscal contribution.
candidates.notes: System-level counterpart to the oil-dominated core.
